subject: science
title: Rocks, Soil and Water
about: The four Earth materials NC names (rocks, minerals, soil, water) and the properties children observe: color, size, shape, texture, solid or liquid, sink or float, magnetic, bendy (ESS.1.2.1). No mineral names are required.
tip: Hand him three rocks and ask him to describe each one with a color word, a size word and a feel word.

cards.q: What are the four Earth materials?
cards.note: Earth materials come from the Earth. People do not make them.
Rocks are made of minerals. Look closely and you can see little specks.

cards.q: Is a rock a solid or a liquid?
cards.note: A solid keeps its shape. A rock stays a rock in your hand or in a cup.

cards.q: Is water in a cup a solid or a liquid?
cards.note: A liquid flows. Water in a cup is a liquid.

cards.q: Which one takes the shape of its cup?
cards.note: A liquid takes the shape of what holds it. A solid does not.

cards.q: Which place has lots of water?
cards.note: Water is in oceans, rivers, lakes and ponds.

cards.q: Soil is the top layer of the ground where...
cards.note: Soil is the top layer of the ground where plants grow.

cards.q: Which rock is small enough to hold in your hand?
cards.note: A pebble is a small rock. A boulder is a very big rock.

cards.q: You drop a pebble in water. What happens?
cards.note: A pebble sinks. Sink or float is something we can test.

cards.q: A magnet pulls on some rocks. What property is that?
cards.note: Some rocks have iron in them. A magnet pulls on those rocks.

cards.q: Which Earth material can you squish and bend when it is wet?
cards.note: Wet clay bends. A rock does not. Bendy is a property too.

cards.q: Which Earth material can you pour?
cards.note: Water pours. It flows from one cup to another.

cards.q: Which word tells a rock's color?
cards.note: Rocks can be gray, brown, black, white or pink.

cards.q: Which word tells how a rock feels?
cards.note: How a rock feels is its texture. It can be rough or smooth.

cards.q: Which word tells a rock's size?
cards.note: Size words are big, small, tiny and huge.

cards.q: Which word tells a rock's shape?
cards.note: Shape words are round, flat, pointy and square.
